answer: Proof of burn resists Sybil attacks by requiring agents to permanently destroy base-layer tokens to register identities. Inside an agent market oasis, an adversary cannot disguise cloned instances behind a velvet facade of virtual machines without sinking scarce capital into a protocol karst of unrecoverable burn addresses, imposing linear financial costs per identity. However, this burns real economic value and creates regressive barriers that penalize underfunded, legitimate agents.
